five_day: 24 rolling-origin fixed-origin five-step forecasts, origins 112..135, targets fully inside validation
fixed_origin: last k observed values only; same mean for every horizon; no future actual or predicted-value updates
five_day_metric: mean absolute error of five-day totals; overlapping windows are not independent
selection: validation comparison only; no final model selected and no test performance claimed
sealed_test: 40 original D9 labels omitted entirely; D10 has no test reader or unseal command
simulation: both series are teaching simulations; hewei is fictional; no measured business benefit
